  "reasons": [
    "The stem describes Management by Exception (analysing deviations). According to NCERT Chapter 8 Controlling (E1.1), dealing only with significant deviations crossing a permissible limit saves managerial time and efforts, and focuses managerial attention on important areas.",
    "Options A, B, and D directly contradict the textbook advantages: it saves rather than consumes time, facilitates rather than hinders delegation, and increases rather than lowers employee morale."

      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "It saves the time and efforts of managers as they deal with only significant deviations.",
      "reason": "Textbook confirms managers examine only significant deviations, saving time."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Delegation of authority becomes harder",
